description: Nelson and Tasman - Top of the South Flood LiDAR Tile Index (2022) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Elevation. This layer contains the Tile Index for LiDAR data in Nelson and Tasman - Top of the South Flood, captured between 23 August 2022 – 6 September 2022. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Elevation. Its tags are New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2026-08-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
